app.name: Malawi Health AI
app.tagline: Check symptoms. Get guidance. Stay healthy.

hero.subtitle: Enter your symptoms and receive AI-powered guidance in seconds. Available in English and Chichewa, on any mobile phone — no app required.

how.label: How it works
how.title: Three steps to health guidance
how.subtitle: Designed for clarity and speed on any device.
how.step1_desc: Select from a list of common symptoms in English or Chichewa.
how.step2_desc: Our model compares your symptoms against patterns of 11 Malawi-priority diseases.
how.step3_desc: See likely conditions with confidence scores, plus prevention and care advice.

diseases.label: Disease coverage
diseases.title: Trained on Malawi-priority conditions
diseases.subtitle: Model validated on diseases with the highest burden in the country.
diseases.note: Predictions are guidance only and do not replace professional medical diagnosis.

ussd.label: Multi-channel access
ussd.title: No smartphone? No problem.
ussd.subtitle: Dial our USSD shortcode on any mobile phone to access the same service — no internet, no data plan, no app required. The full prediction engine works on feature phones.

features.label: System capabilities
features.title: Built for the Malawian context
features.ai_desc: Trained on symptom patterns of Malawi-priority diseases using XGBoost, SVM, and Random Forest.
features.channels_desc: Smartphone users get a rich web interface. Feature phone users dial a shortcode.
features.language_desc: Full support for English and Chichewa, with medical terms from published vocabularies.
features.security_desc: Symptoms are never shared. Optional accounts save history securely under Malawi's Data Protection Act.

final_cta.title: Ready to check your symptoms?
final_cta.subtitle: It takes less than a minute. Free, private, and available in your language.

step1.title: What are you feeling?
step1.subtitle: Select all symptoms that apply to you right now.

step2.title: A bit more about you
step2.subtitle: This helps us give a more accurate prediction.
step2.duration: How long have you had these symptoms?

step3.title: Review your answers
step3.subtitle: Check everything looks right before we predict.

result.title: Possible condition
result.disclaimer: This is not a medical diagnosis. If symptoms are severe or worsening, seek care immediately.
result.signin_nudge_desc: Create a free account to keep a history of your health checks and track trends over time.

about.title: About this system
about.intro: Malawi Health AI is an academic project that uses machine learning to help identify likely diseases based on reported symptoms, with prevention guidance tailored to Malawi.
about.mission: Make early health guidance accessible to every Malawian — whether they use a smartphone or a feature phone.
about.tech_body: The system uses three machine learning models — XGBoost, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machine — trained on symptom-disease data filtered to Malawi priority diseases.
about.disclaimer: This system is not a substitute for professional medical care.

footer.disclaimer: Not a medical diagnosis. Always consult a qualified health worker for serious symptoms.
